title: Windows-native VIXEN configure cannot resolve the WSL worktree
body: Queued `cmd.exe /c build.bat configure vixen-ninja` from the WSL UNC worktree failed with `UNC paths are not supported` and `vswhere.exe not found at C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe`. The documented `vixen-wsl` preset through the live queue recovered the configure. The native launcher should translate the worktree path and check Visual Studio discovery before attempting configure.

title: Capture runner interprets relative output paths from the binary directory
body: The queued capture command using relative output `.tmp/starlight-before` failed with `Expected native capture was not produced`. The app runs from `build/wsl/binaries`, so it tried to write there instead of the repository path. Re-running the same capture with an absolute output directory succeeded; canonicalize the output root in the runner before launching either app.

title: SPT task lookup requires an unavailable workspace config
body: The required show command for T-1139 could not load the expected yeroket-stack.local.json from the declared scope. The inline task brief supplied the acceptance criteria, so work continued; make scoped task lookup self-contained or provide a clear fallback when a workspace config is absent.
